entries.label: began
entries.behavior: snapshot current state, prepare opposite-target animator, pause it, store actual fractionComplete as dragBeginFractionComplete, apply translation progress

entries.label: changed
entries.behavior: pause animator, clear reversed flag, calculate translation fraction, setFractionComplete

entries.label: ended
entries.behavior: project translation and settle to endpoint

entries.label: cancelled
entries.behavior: same native branch as ended; do not independently force the original endpoint

entries.label: failed
entries.behavior: keyboard snapshot/coordinator update and state/layout synchronization; exact service payload not decoded

lifecycle_reuse.interruption: Pan began pauses existing animator and records actual fractionComplete; pan changed continues from that saved value. Reinitializing beginFraction to0/1 would jump when interrupting animation.

lifecycle_reuse.keyboard: Began/ended/failed branch accesses existing keyboardSnapshotCoordinator; full official keyboard snapshot lifecycle is not recovered by arithmetic alone.
lifecycle_reuse.completion: onTransitionCompleted belongs to same container; existing transition identity approach remains independent host adaptation.
